name: Reclaim.ai
description: Reclaim.ai is an AI calendar assistant that automatically schedules meetings, tasks, habits, and focus time to optimize a person's or team's calendar.
best_for: Individuals and teams who want their calendar to automatically protect focus time and schedule tasks around meetings.
features: AI Focus Time that defends uninterrupted work blocks based on weekly goals
AI Habits that schedules recurring routines into optimal time slots
AI Tasks that syncs and schedules to-do lists by priority
Smart Meetings that find the best time across attendees' calendars
AI scheduling links for external meeting booking
Buffer time that auto-schedules breaks and travel around meetings
Calendar sync across Google Calendar and Outlook
Integrations with Slack, Zoom, Asana, Jira, ClickUp, Todoist, and Linear

pricing.starting_price: Lite: free forever; Starter: $10/seat/month billed yearly

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Yearly plan for organizations over 100 seats.

cons: The free Lite plan is limited to one user, a one-week scheduling range, one calendar sync, and one scheduling link.
Paid pricing is per seat; Starter and Business cap team size at 10 and 100 seats respectively.

alternatives.best_for: Professionals wanting AI to auto-schedule their day

alternatives.name: Calendly

alternatives.best_for: Individuals and teams booking one-off or recurring meetings
